per_update_boundary: At each monthly UTC update boundary T, evaluate horizons of 30, 90, and 365 calendar days using left-closed/right-open intervals [T - h, T).
For each frozen horizon h, select active strict_valid_pair rows with timestamp_utc in [T - h, T).
Exclude warning-review, excluded, placeholder, calendar-only, invalid, synthetic, and descriptive-only rows.
Require at least 1000 prior strict-valid rows independently for each horizon; otherwise mark that horizon unavailable.
For each available horizon, compute p99.5 over strict-valid spread values using V1 quantile semantics: rank = q * (n - 1) with linear interpolation.
If one or more horizons are available, return the maximum numeric threshold among all available horizon thresholds at full precision with no operational rounding.
If no horizons are available, return unavailable/error; warmup remains unavailable until any horizon is eligible.
Apply coverage later as covered iff observed_spread <= threshold.
Do not carry forward, future-backfill, or use non-strict fallback rows.

leakage_protections: No warning-review, placeholder, excluded, invalid, synthetic, or descriptive-only rows in primary baseline.
No full-period or future-period descriptive statistics as threshold inputs.
No 2023 or 2025 final holdout access before explicit final release.
No 2015+ data acquisition or inspection under this mission.
No parameter selection by comparing candidate outcomes on 2011-2014.
Every output must record source artifacts, policy version, horizon availability diagnostics, and update boundary timestamp.
